messages:
maria: FYI customer hit the rerank endpoint and got a 413. They sent ~2k docs and a long query, UX shows 'Input too large' which confused them. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/12345

devon: Can you paste the request shape and the exact error body? Which model/route were they calling?

maria: Curl excerpt and response:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
 -d '{"query":"what are the top fixes for billing errors when re-ranking search results...","docs":[...2000 items...]}'
```
Response: `\{\"error\":\"413 Payload too large: total_chars=4200000 > limit=2000000\"\}`

alex: Thanks — that payload error is accurate but the customer-facing message is too generic. Suggest we change to something like: `Payload too large: max_docs=1000 or max_chars=2000000 exceeded (docs=2000, chars=4200000)` so they know whether to trim doc count vs doc length.

tara: Agreed. Short-term reply to customer: advise batching or pre-filtering (use embeddings + top-k retrieval then rerank that smaller set). Also offer a helper script to chunk docsets into batches of 250 docs.

devon: Can we also add a client-side pre-check in our SDKs returning a clearer error before sending? e.g. compute total_chars and early-raise with suggestions. I can open a small PR.

maria: Please do. I'll update the support reply templates: 1) explain limit types (docs vs chars), 2) give quick workarounds (chunking, retrieve+rerank top candidates), 3) link to docs section.

alex: For product/ops: file a tiny change to the API error payload to include fields {"limit_type":"chars|docs","limit":2000000,"current":4200000} so SDKs and UIs can show precise guidance.

support-bot: Case 12345 marked escalated -> rerank-limits. Assigned to devon and alex. :rotating_light:

maria: We'll propose the error-payload change as an unobtrusive patch (no behavior change, just richer JSON). If approved I'll include it in the support KB with sample client-side checks and example code snippets.

devon: Opening PR now for SDK pre-check + unit tests. ETA EOD.

tara: Nice. For the immediate customer reply I'll send the batch script and recommend using embeddings => top-100 => rerank. Keep me posted if they need a one-off increase.

alex: Also add a small note in the console UI that flags when a rerank request would exceed limits before submission. UX follow-up ticket here: https://linear.example/RED-789

maria: Thanks team — closing loop once PRs merged and support KB updated. :white_check_mark:
